decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - To vary condition 6 of advertisement consent 00505/A0/AD19 dated 26 August 1999, to allow display of permanent signs of a corporate nature.
It is considered that the application to vary condition 6 of planning permission 00505/AO/AD19, dated 26 August 1999, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of 27 Great West Road and would not be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoinig and neighbourhood properties, or highway safety.   The  development is in accordance with Policies ENVB 1.1 (New Development) and ENVB 1.4 (Advertisements) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
Informative: The variation of this condition does not preclude the continuance of the Town and Country Planning (Control of Advertisements) Regulations 1992 on this property.
Informative: This variation of this condition does not preclude the remainder of the conditions of advertisement consent 00505/A0/AD19, dated 26 August 1999, from continuing to apply.
description: Removal of Condition 6 (Permanent signs to be of a corporate nature related to occupiers) of planning permission 00505/AO/AD19 dated 26 August 1999 to allow display of signs of a corporate nature either related or not related to occupiers of the building.
